title: 第一章 继承p站，制作人系统？
slug: 华娱从继承视频网站开始
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

2013年2月。

京城朝阳区某处写字楼里。

今天是大年初五，本是喜庆的日子，这里却是一片愁云惨淡。

“抵给搜狐好啊，以后我们就是搜狐员工了...”

“嘘，小声点。”

“.....”

这是个好事啊。

去搜狐，无论是福利待遇，还是工作前景都比留在p站这个没有盈利能力的中小型ugc网站要好。

他们对于公司即将被搜狐收购这件事喜闻乐见。

当然，大部人的心情是截然相反的。

两人的窃窃私语引来不少人怒视的目光。

p站员工就三四十人，大部分都是跟着老苏总从创业时期坚持过来的。

他们不愿意看到网站被抵押的结果。

可无论是愿意还是不愿意的员工，都只能等着办公室里的小苏总做出决定。

但小苏总也别无选择了，网站盈收不多，还有两个月对赌协议就要失败了。

除了把手里的p站股份抵偿给搜狐，以股抵债，小苏总好像没有别的路了。

总经理办公室，年轻的苏行舟看着桌面上一堆堆的资料，他还有点懵。

我重生了？

苏行舟花了点时间确认这个消息，双拳握了握，压制住心中翻涌的情绪和杂乱的思绪。

“行舟，不用逼自己，这不是你的错，老苏在九泉之下也不会怪你的。”

钟大强叹了口气，看着苏行舟这个状态有点心疼。

他以为苏行舟还在为老苏的突然去世难过，为对赌协议即将失败的压力紧绷着。

钟大强不想看到苏行舟年纪轻轻的背负那么大压力。

“钟叔？”

苏行舟看到熟悉的中年面孔推门进来，对自己重生这件事有了更清晰的实感。

钟大强是他爸的发小，也是p站的副总经理，他爸的左膀右臂。

钟大强和苏家的关系不止是工作上这么简单，苏行舟知道钟大强拿自己当亲儿子了。

上一世，卖掉p站之后，钟大强还时刻关心着苏行舟，在他遇到困难的时候出手帮助，任劳任怨。

可以说，这世界上苏行舟只剩一个可以信任的人，那就是钟大强了。

“虽然他走前没留下遗言，但是你要相信，老苏只希望你能过得好。”

钟大强安慰着苏行舟，即使他也对p站要被卖掉这件事难以接受。

p站是苏行舟父亲在08年一手创办的中型ugc（用户创作生产内容）视频分享平台，走小而精，高粘性，低成本盈利路线，区别于巨头的烧钱版权站，定位清晰且差异化明显。

逐渐做大后，p站在10年接受了搜狐3000万的a轮融资，出让20%股权。

在当时，视频网站融资签对赌合同是行业常规操作。

p站和搜狐签了一份为期三年的1.2亿的盈收总额合同。

未达目标，p站需以本金+8%年化回购搜狐股权。

如果拿不出这笔钱回购，那就成了欠款，只能以p站剩余股份抵债。

典型的互联网大厂放贷式扶持。

进入到2013年，视频网站格局已经初成。

虽然此时几乎没有能够盈利的视频网站，p站勉强做到盈亏平衡，处于视频网站第二梯队。

不得不说，苏行舟是个小天才。

苏行舟去年考入北电导演系之后，组建团队制作短篇剧情小短剧，p站还多了自制内容板块。

不同于某播的暴力涩情，也不同于自制喜剧的诙谐。

他带着同学拍出来的短片内容介于二者之间，那种剧情中带着料，料里带着剧情的短片，吸引了不少用户。

Page (1/3)

February 2013.

In an office building somewhere in Chaoyang District, Beijing.

Today is the fifth day of the Lunar New Year. It is supposed to be a festive day, but here it is a gloomy and gloomy day.

"It's good to give it to Sohu. We will be Sohu employees from now on..."

"Shh, keep your voice down."

"..."

This is a good thing.

Going to Sohu, both in terms of benefits and job prospects, is better than staying at P Station, a small and medium-sized UGC website with no profitability.

They are happy to hear that the company is about to be acquired by Sohu.

Of course, most people feel exactly the opposite.

The whispers between the two attracted angry looks from many people.

There are only thirty or forty employees at Station P, most of whom have followed Mr. Su from his entrepreneurial days.

They don't want to see the results of the website being mortgaged.

But whether they are willing or unwilling employees, they can only wait for Mr. Su in the office to make a decision.

But Mr. Su has no choice. The website is not making much profit, and the betting agreement will fail in two months.

Xiao Su seemed to have no other choice but to compensate Sohu for his shares in Station P and pay off debts with shares.

In the general manager's office, young Su Xingzhou looked at the piles of information on the table, and he was still a little confused.

Am I reborn?

Su Xingzhou took a moment to confirm the news and clenched his fists to suppress the surging emotions and messy thoughts in his heart.

"Xingzhou, don't force yourself, it's not your fault, and Lao Su won't blame you even if he's under Jiuquan."

Zhong Daqiang sighed, feeling a little distressed seeing Su Xingzhou in this state.

He thought that Su Xingzhou was still sad about Lao Su's sudden death, and tensed up under the pressure that the gambling agreement was about to fail.

Zhong Daqiang didn't want to see Su Xingzhou bear so much pressure at such a young age.

"Uncle Zhong?"

When Su Xingzhou saw a familiar middle-aged face push through the door, he had a clearer understanding of his rebirth.

Zhong Daqiang is his father's childhood friend, the deputy general manager of Station P, and his father's right-hand man.

The relationship between Zhong Daqiang and the Su family goes beyond work. Su Xingzhou knew that Zhong Daqiang regarded him as his own son.

In the last life, after selling the p station, Zhong Daqiang still cared about Su Xingzhou and helped him when he encountered difficulties, working hard and without complaint.

It can be said that there is only one person left in the world that Su Xingzhou can trust, and that is Zhong Daqiang.

"Although he didn't leave any last words before he left, you have to believe that Lao Su only hopes that you can live well."

Zhong Daqiang comforted Su Xingzhou, even though he could not accept the fact that station p was going to be sold.

Site p is a medium-sized UGC (user-generated content) video sharing platform founded by Su Xingzhou’s father in 2008. It is small but sophisticated, highly sticky, and low-cost profitable. It is different from the money-burning copyright sites of giants. It has clear positioning and obvious differentiation.

After gradually growing in size, P Station received 30 million yuan in Series A financing from Sohu in 2010 and transferred 20% of its equity.

At that time, it was a common practice in the industry for video websites to finance and sign gambling contracts.

Station p and Sohu signed a three-year contract with a total revenue of 120 million yuan.

If the target is not reached, P Station needs to repurchase Sohu's equity at the principal + 8% annualized rate.

If you cannot come up with the money to buy back, it will become a debt, and you can only use the remaining shares of station P to pay off the debt.

Typical loan-based support from major Internet companies.

Entering 2013, the video website landscape has begun to take shape.

Although there are almost no profitable video websites at this time, Station P can barely break even and is in the second echelon of video websites.

I have to say that Su Xingzhou is a little genius.

After Su Xingzhou was admitted to Nortel's Directing Department last year, he formed a team to produce short dramas. The p station also added a self-made content section.

It is different from the violent and sentimental show of a certain show, and it is also different from the humor of a homemade comedy.

The content of the short film he and his classmates made was somewhere between the two. The short film contained material in the plot and plot in the material, which attracted many users.
